query: For high-entropy-alloy coatings used in wear-resistant applications, what single intervention could improve wear resistance across operating temperatures? Formulate one hypothesis specifying the intervention, its expected mechanism, the predicted improvement relative to an otherwise identical unmodified coating, the temperature and sliding conditions under which it should hold, the prior evidence supporting it, and an experiment with a clear result that would falsify it.

generation.hypothesis: Adding vanadium to high-entropy alloy coatings can improve wear resistance across operating temperatures.
generation.material_initial_state: high-entropy alloy coatings without vanadium addition
generation.intervention: adding vanadium to the high-entropy alloy coatings
generation.conditions: operating temperatures up to 750 °C, sliding conditions with a counterpart material
generation.structural_mediator: formation of a layered oxide structure on the surface of the coating
generation.mechanism: the layered oxide structure promotes wear resistance by reducing friction and preventing abrasive wear, as seen in records node::10.1016/j.triboint.2022.107523 and node::10.1016/j.jmrt.2023.02.098
generation.predicted_outcome: improved wear resistance of the high-entropy alloy coatings with vanadium addition, with a predicted reduction in wear rate of at least 20% compared to the unmodified coating
generation.baseline: wear rate of the unmodified high-entropy alloy coating
generation.boundary: operating temperatures above 750 °C, where the coating may degrade or oxidize excessively
generation.uncertainty: the exact mechanism of wear resistance improvement and the optimal amount of vanadium addition are still uncertain and require further investigation

falsification_experiment.design: sliding wear test of high-entropy alloy coatings with and without vanadium addition, using a counterpart material and operating temperatures up to 750 °C
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: if the wear rate of the coating with vanadium addition is not significantly lower than that of the unmodified coating, the hypothesis is falsified
